rv.q: This is a gritty, exciting and joyously inspiring musical. It's a celebration of the passion and strength we all harbor deep inside of us.
My friends and I LOVED this production- see if you do, too.
The choreography (Clayton Cross) is marvelous and the direction (Kyle A. Dougan)works in spite of some tech problems.

cn.t: Music Theater Works' production of "Billy Elliot" earns modest praise from critics, with scores in the 70-80 range. The coming-of-age story set during the UK miners' strike resonates, though opening night issues were noted.
